checks.name: Create returns Location and initial ETag
Identical creation retry recovers receipt without writing
Detail and raw reads preserve bytes without counting views or leaking keys
Null, missing, duplicate, unknown and malformed JSON are rejected
Oversized HTTP bodies cannot reach persistence
Foreign write origins and unexpected hosts are rejected
Deletion requires the capability header; URL keys grant no access
Update enforces quoted ETags and rejects stale drafts
Unlisted content is directly readable but absent from public search
Literal search, language filtering and bounded pagination work over HTTP
Corrupt storage returns a recovery error and preserves the original bytes
Versioned deletion cannot be undone by retrying an old create
Unknown API routes return JSON instead of the application page
Server restart retains accepted workspace bytes
Rate limits return a bounded retry response
CLI migration preserves bytes and legacy UTF-8 capabilities work over HTTP
